name: FedEx Express Regional Hub - Oakland CA

fieldNotes.siteConfirmation: Roster address (8455 Pardee Dr) is a FedEx Ship Center - a customer-facing retail/pickup site about 2 miles from the airport, NOT the regional hub. Web research established the FedEx Express Oakland Regional Hub (the West Coast hub) is at 1 Sally Ride Way, Oakland CA 94621, on the airside at Oakland International Airport - a ~233,000 sq ft air/ground/trucking sort center able to sort ~12,000 packages/day for the Bay Area. Satellite at 37.72011,-122.21957 confirmed multiple FedEx sort buildings, an aircraft maintenance hangar, FedEx-livery freighter aircraft (purple/red tails) at airside positions, ULD/dolly staging, and rooftop solar. Street View confirmed a barbed-wire secured airport perimeter with 'Restricted Area / Authorized Personnel Only' signage. Locked center 37.72011, -122.21957.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The FedEx hub sits entirely inside the secured OAK airport perimeter - Street View at the perimeter road shows barbed-wire chain-link fence and a 'No Trespassing / Restricted Area / Authorized Personnel' sign. Truck access into the hub is through a controlled airport security gate off Air Cargo Way. A controlled truck gate is inferred from this secured-airport context; the FedEx-specific gate could not be directly imaged (no public Street View on the internal hub roads). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Secured-airport air-cargo hubs of this scale are staffed/guarded at the controlled access point; guardShack inferred true at medium confidence, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False given an inferred staffed entry; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved areas inside the secured fence between the access road and the dock/ramp allow trucks to hold; inferred, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide internal airside roads and apron give a long approach with room for a 3+ truck queue; inferred, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Z20 imagery shows trailers backed into dock doors along the building landside face plus ULD container rows; estimated 25-50 doors band, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers and tractors parked along internal roads and ULD staging rows; estimated 25-50 band, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus includes multiple sort buildings, an aircraft maintenance hangar, and support structures - a multi-building hub.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer/ULD staging areas on the landside function as a drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Air-to-ground hub; docks not clearly split into separate ship vs receive banks - false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; airside cargo facility.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box approximates the FedEx hub footprint (buildings + ramp + landside); ~70 acres estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Major-metro airport (Oakland) in the dense Bay Area; Urban.
fieldNotes.confidenceNote: Medium overall: facility positively identified (FedEx freighters on the ramp are conclusive), but the truck-gate and guard-shack specifics could not be directly imaged - the FedEx access point is inside the secured airport and not covered by public Street View. Gate/guard-shack calls are inferred and flagged.
